newsitem.title: USA: Whitman bottler unit Q3 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Whitman bottler unit Q3 profit up.

text.p: Whitman Corp said Wednesday its Pepsi-Cola General Bottlers unit reported an operating profit of $70.2 million for the third quarter, up from $66.8 million a year ago.
Bottler revenue for the quarter rose to $426.5 million from $424.8 million.
Whitman said these results reflect improved performance in both domestic and international operations.
Pepsi-Cola General Bottlers' domestic sales were essentially flat compared with last year's exceptionally strong third quarter, Whitman said.
Bottler domestic case volume increased more than three percent in the quarter, led by stronger sales to supermarkets.

Sales in Poland, where Pepsi-Cola General Bottlers has an operation, increased 11 percent to $14.6 million in the third quarter. Operating losses in Poland narrowed to $1.4 million from a loss of $2.9 million a year ago.
Whitman said its Midas International third quarter operating income dropped to $26.5 million from $29.5 million. Sales and revenues rose 4.8 percent to $168.7 million from $160.9 million.
